dedupe_keys.name: chinese meridian project data centre 子午工程数据中心

description: The Chinese Meridian Project data centre distributes the observations and data products of the Meridian Project, China's chain of ground-based space environment stations run by the National Space Science Center of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. The portal offers data product and data search, a list of datasets with DOIs (added in June 2026), a mapping of renamed phase-one products, the mid-latitude HF radar and a cDST index, space weather forecasts, and computing, model and software resources, plus a data policy and user services for subscriptions, favourites and bulk download. News on the site reports research built on its data, such as mid-latitude aurora and ionospheric disturbances. Coverage is China, along the meridian chains of stations. Format and access: a Chinese and English web portal where registered users search and download products; formats vary by instrument. Licence: governed by the project's data policy, which was not read; free. Caveats: the data subdomain did not resolve from the cloud, and service pauses are announced. It supports hazard exposure analysis of geomagnetic and ionospheric storms for grids and GNSS in East Asia. Related catalogue records are INTERMAGNET and SuperMAG, which hold complementary magnetometer data.
